fact: The Civil Status Division announced on 18 March 2026 that the Baie du Cap Civil Status Office would be operational on Tuesdays and Thursdays and the Grand Bois Civil Status Office on Wednesdays and Fridays, with effect from 1 April 2026; it says nothing of the CSD System.
title: Communiqué: Baie du Cap and Grand Bois Civil Status Offices
publisher: Civil Status Division, Prime Minister's Office
